hazards.description: The location under the bridge with massive concrete supports creates a hostile, isolated environment with no 'eyes on the street'.

hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or protected walkway on this elevated roadway, forcing any pedestrian into high-speed traffic lanes.

hazards.name: High-Speed Environment
hazards.description: The road design (elevated, concrete barriers, wide lanes) suggests high vehicle speeds which are lethal to pedestrians.

hazards.name: High-speed traffic proximity
hazards.description: Pedestrians are separated from high-speed multi-lane traffic only by a low concrete barrier and guardrail.

hazards.description: The walkway is extremely narrow and contains significant debris, making it difficult to navigate safely.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install raised, paved sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated and safe space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Add lighting specifically aimed at the walkway areas under the bridge to improve visibility and security.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or lane narrowing to reduce vehicle speeds in this high-risk industrial corridor.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer and Greenery
interventions.description: Install a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Clearance and Maintenance
interventions.description: Enforce parking regulations to remove vehicles from the sidewalk and implement regular cleaning to remove debris.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a wide, paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a continuous and safe path for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility crosswalks to define safe crossing points across the wide, unmarked roadway.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-quality, pedestrian-scale LED lighting under the overpass to improve visibility and perceived safety.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Obstacle Removal
interventions.description: Widen the sidewalk and relocate the utility pole to ensure a clear, accessible path for all users.

interventions.title: Under-Bridge Activation
interventions.description: Improve the area under the bridge with landscaping, better fencing, or public art to reduce the 'dead space' effect.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Completion
interventions.description: Construct wide, ADA-compliant sidewalks on both sides of the street to provide a dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks with high-visibility patterns to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) at potential crossing points to increase pedestrian visibility and reduce the unprotected crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Midblock Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to provide a designated safe crossing point.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Buffer Zone
interventions.description: Add a planting strip or street trees between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Widening
interventions.description: Repair the degraded sidewalk surfaces and widen the narrow walkway on the right to meet accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Dedicated Pedestrian Walkway
interventions.description: Construct a paved, protected sidewalk with physical separation from the roadway area to provide a safe path through the underpass.

interventions.title: Enhanced Underpass Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-quality, pedestrian-scale lighting to eliminate dark spots and improve personal security and visibility.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the area and implement regular cleaning to remove debris and maintain a clear walking surface.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-output, pedestrian-scale LED lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety in the shadowed area.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer
interventions.description: Install a physical barrier or a wider furniture zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Planting Strip
interventions.description: Install a landscaped buffer between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from vehicles.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Reconstruct and widen the sidewalks to provide a clear, ADA-compliant path that is not obstructed by utility infrastructure.

interventions.title: Under-bridge lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity LED lighting to improve visibility and security for pedestrians.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk
interventions.description: Mark a clear, high-visibility pedestrian crossing if this is a designated walking route.

interventions.title: High-visibility crosswalk markings
interventions.description: Upgrade the existing crosswalk to high-visibility continental markings to increase driver awareness at the intersection.

interventions.title: Install High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add marked crosswalks with high-visibility paint to define safe crossing points and alert drivers to pedestrian presence.

interventions.title: Improve Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Install bright, pedestrian-scale lighting under the elevated structure to improve visibility and personal security.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Buffering
interventions.description: Widen the existing sidewalk and add a buffer zone to separate pedestrians from moving traffic and parked vehicles.

interventions.title: Physical Buffers
interventions.description: Install bollards, planters, or a furniture zone to provide physical and psychological separation from the roadway.

interventions.title: Public Art and Placemaking
interventions.description: Use murals or lighting installations on the bridge supports to mitigate the hostile industrial feel of the environment.

interventions.title: Grade-separated pedestrian crossing
interventions.description: Construct a pedestrian bridge or underpass to allow safe crossing of the highway without conflict with high-speed traffic.

interventions.title: Physically separated multi-use path
interventions.description: Install a heavy-duty concrete barrier to create a wide, protected path for pedestrians and cyclists separated from the highway lanes.

interventions.title: Roadway resurfacing
interventions.description: Repair and resurface the degraded pavement to eliminate tripping hazards and improve vehicle control.

interventions.title: Separated Multi-use Path
interventions.description: Install a physically separated walkway or multi-use path with a crash-rated barrier to provide safe passage across the bridge/elevated section.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Fencing
interventions.description: If pedestrian access is prohibited, ensure clear signage and physical barriers prevent accidental or intentional entry onto the high-speed roadway.

interventions.title: Walkway Widening
interventions.description: Increase the width of the pedestrian walkway to meet minimum accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Enhanced Physical Barrier
interventions.description: Install a taller, more robust crash-rated barrier to better protect pedestrians from high-speed vehicle incursions.

interventions.title: Maintenance and Debris Removal
interventions.description: Regularly clear the walkway of dirt and debris to ensure a clear, safe walking surface.

interventions.title: Physical barrier and signage
interventions.description: Ensure continuous physical barriers and clear signage to prevent pedestrians from entering the high-speed roadway and to direct them to safe routes.
